reviews.author: David Andras
reviews.text: The owner is a true master at his craft and his pricing is very reasonable. I was genuinely impressed. We also installed Starlink up in the tree which was pretty incredible.

reviews.author: Nancy Smith
reviews.text: Jeremy Ross is the ultimate professional. He did an excellent job of taking dead limbs off and other tree related issues. He was as respectful of our trees as we could wish. He cleaned up the area completely. I would recommend Bald Eagle Tree Expert to everyone. His price was very reasonable. We are only going to use him from now on. His know how and knowledge of trees was exceptional. First class.

reviews.author: Daniel Ward
reviews.text: Jeremy was very professional, responsive, fare and timely. I would go as far as saying above and beyond the scope of work laid out. I will certainly use Bald Eagle services again.

reviews.author: Jose Torres
reviews.text: Excellent experience in removal of trees to prepare site for construction. Jeremy was super responsive and accommodating to work with our schedule to remove trees. He and his crew were professional and experienced with very fair pricing. Definitely will use his company for future tree removal/maintenance.

reviews.author: Stephen Dunn
reviews.text: As a former ISA certified arborist (now aged into a different line of work) I have often lamented the lack of professionalism and adherence to industry standards I see everywhere I look. I had the pleasure to meet Jeremy today and I am so glad to see his great knowledge, professionalism, and true concern for the well-being of trees. The future is in capable hands. I would absolutely trust this young man to perform at the highest level of professional tree care.

reviews.author: jennifer gulick
reviews.text: As a Certified Arborist myself, I know good quality tree work and well-trained, knowledgable tree workers. I hired Bald Eagle Tree Experts to remove 2 trees very close to my home, and they completed the project very professionally and without incident. The next day, our neighbor even commented on how well the clean-up was done. We are super satisfied with Jeremy and his staff, and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Adele
reviews.text: Jeremy came out to trim up a tree for me. I was impressed. Not only is he reliable and reasonable but he is conscientious of how/where to cut. He didn't just chop up the tree. He's knowledgeable and cares about the health of the tree. I highly recommend Bald Eagle Tree Expert services!

reviews.author: Stu Southwood
reviews.text: We were super happy with his work. Trey was very careful preventing any damage to our house and roof. We would definitely recommend his business. We will use him in the future for sure.

reviews.author: Malcolm Wilson
reviews.text: Jeremy was professional and personable. We needed a tree taken down and he was prompt, reasonable, and fast. We would definitely use his service again... Thanks for a job well done. Malcolm Wilson

reviews.author: Mike&Beth Hopkins
reviews.text: We highly recommend Jeremy and his crew. They did a wonderful job removing several trees around our home.

reviews.author: BigRich Johnson
reviews.text: Great to work with! Fast, courteous and professional in an emergency situation. Thank you so much for rushing here and getting the road cleared. Highly recommend working with Bald Eagle Tree Expert.

reviews.author: Acct 4 Dedo
reviews.text: Great service and very fair prices. Bald Eagle has done my trees for a couple years. Recommend to everyone in my area.
